findings.passage: We must ensure the security of, and confidence in, our elections!
findings.note: Campaign issues page, section titled Free & Fair Elections, opening line.

findings.passage: This begins by requiring Voter ID, something only the far left (including our current Secretary of State) does not support.
findings.note: Campaign issues page says election security begins with requiring voter ID.

findings.passage: We must codify our best practices – clean up the Voter Registration file, harden the security of our voting systems and ballots, and establish procedures for in-depth auditing of both.
findings.note: Campaign issues page lists voter-roll cleanup, system security and audits.

findings.motion: House: not adopted Roll Call #79 Yeas 58 Nays 48 Excused 0 Not Voting 4
findings.note: House roll call as printed ('Greene, J.'), linked to Jaime Greene (district 65) via the official 2025 House member roll (identity step 2026-10-28).

findings.motion: co sponsor, Introduced text only (2025-HIJR-B.htm). The bill page lists no posted text of the House substitute H-1 adopted 2025-04-30 (HJ 41 Pg. 438), so the roll call on adoption (2025-05-01, not adopted 58-48, needs two-thirds) was on text that is not in this file. Quotes below are from the introduced text; section labels are Article II sections as printed.
